title: SQL Injection Probe Detected in HTTP Request
description: HTTP request URI or query string contains common SQL injection payloads.
remediation: Block offending IP in WAF, inspect backend DB logs for successful queries, and ensure parameterized queries.

title: Path Traversal / Local File Inclusion Attempt
description: HTTP request attempts directory traversal or sensitive system file access.
remediation: Block source IP, verify web server path sanitization, and check HTTP 200 responses for data exfiltration.

title: Automated Web Vulnerability Scanner / Recon Burst
description: High volume of HTTP 403/404 responses from a single IP indicating directory or vulnerability scanning.
remediation: Rate-limit or block scanner IP at WAF/CDN and review exposed endpoints.
